meaning.text: 在比较有余地的条件下，天机可以表现为「有停止规则的适应性思考」。当条件收紧时，则可能出现「思路碎裂、犹豫或不断重做计划」。与其把两者看成互相排斥的结论，不如观察环境、责任和可用支持改变时，表达是如何转变的。

meaning.text: Approach inner fulfilment and self-expectation through Wellbeing. Ju Men in Wellbeing corresponds to make hidden assumptions discussable: an entry for observation that needs checking against experience. Tai Yin in Life also brings build depth before exposing or spending what is held. The two functions need not be equally prominent in every situation.

meaning.text: With sufficient room, Ju Men can express precise questioning that improves shared understanding. These are conditional alternatives: observe how expression changes with the environment, responsibilities and available support.

meaning.text: A further condition in Life is deep reserve that can be shared when needed. If it instead moves into over-withdrawal, secrecy or silent accumulation of pressure, it cannot be assumed to offset the earlier pressure. Compare whether time alone restores room to choose or leaves unfinished demands active; this is more useful than deciding whether a star is simply good or bad.
